source.name: Nashville SC: 'Nashville Soccer Club and Renasant Agree to Contract Extension'
source.quote: their partnership extension through 2027, a four-year renewal. Nashville SC first signed Renasant Bank in 2019
source.note: Renasant became the club's first jersey sponsor on 26 September 2019 (club announcement: https://www.nashvillesc.com/news/nashville-sc-signs-renasant-first-jersey-sponsor), on the shirt since the inaugural 2020 MLS season; the April 2023 extension runs through 2027. No deal value was disclosed.
